Name: Additional Fish
Author: SiberClaw
Description:
This mod adds brand new fish to lakes, rivers and shores of Stardew Valley. All fish have unique fishpond products which may help in your journey to perfection!

V1.0.0 adds Fish to the mountain lake:
Spring Fish:
- Dusty Trout (6am - 7pm Sunny)
- Carved Bass (7pm - 2am)
- Lonely Bullhead (6am - 2am Rain)

Summer Fish:
- Bronzed Trout (6am - 7pm Sunny)
- Dwarfed Bass (7pm - 2am)
- Studious Bullhead (6am - 2am Rain)

Fall Fish:
- Gold Trout (6am - 7pm Sunny)
- Starry Bass (7pm - 2am Sunny)
- Creative Bullhead (6am - 2am Rain)

Winter Fish:
- Iced Trout (6am - 7pm Sunny)
- Smooth Bass (7pm - 2am)
- Adventurous Bullhead (6am - 2am)
- ?????? (10pm-2am)

Downloads.Description: Updated to fix a bug showing incorrect fish pond data for the former 'Golden Trout' fish - now named the 'Gold Trout'. Updating will cause all Golden Trout fish to be a placeholder item which will need to be deleted.
